content:
To clone your private repository, I'll need a few things:

1. **Your GitHub username** — so I can construct the correct URL (e.g. `github.com/your-username/Grepo`)
2. **Authentication** — one of:
   - A **Personal Access Token (PAT)** from GitHub (Settings → Developer settings → Personal access tokens)
   - Or confirm if you have an **SSH key** already set up on this machine (`~/.ssh/id_rsa` or `~/.ssh/id_ed25519`)

Also, please confirm **git is now installed** by running `git --version` in your terminal.

Once I have these, I can clone the repo and set up the remote for you!
